Rae (CS): Quick status for Aurora Labs private/VPC onboarding. Blockers: egress IPs, transit attachment, and customer asks for KMS alias format + rotation window. Renewal note: flagged as watch if cutover > Jun 5.

Marcus (Network): We can reserve 2 EIPs in eu-west-1. I'll post them by EOD. Need their firewall to confirm outbound ports (usually 443, 9000).

Ivy (SE): KMS recommendation: customer-managed CMK, rotation every 90 days. Suggested alias: alias/redwood/auroralabs-eu.

Liam (SRE): Audit logs: Aurora prefers HEC token over TLS (no mTLS). They'll share token via secure ticket. We'll map fields to their schema on our collector.

Nora (PM): I'll flag renewal timeline in CRM. If any blocker remains 72hrs before Jun 5, Sales wants an exec check-in.

Marcus (Network): EIPs reserved: 3.250.12.77, 3.250.12.78. Pushing route patch now.

Ivy (SE): Small KMS snippet for runbook:

```
# alias example
alias/redwood/auroralabs-eu -> aws-kms-key-xxxx
rotation: 90d
```

Liam (SRE): Got the token via ticket #289. I'll configure HEC shipper and run a smoke test tomorrow 08:30 PT.

onboard-bot: Checklist updated: "EIPs reserved" checked; "HEC token received" checked; "KMS runbook" in progress. https://redwood.example.com/checklists/aurora-labs

Rae (CS): Thanks team, meeting tomorrow 9am PT to confirm cutover plan. :white_check_mark:
